title: Two of you build one railway

steps.text: In the default place game or ?proto=place&coop=1, each tab puts its arrival tick in its presence. The oldest visible tab is the authority: the one that decides.
How many logs you carry goes in your presence too, so your partner sees the stack on your back.
You drop a log at a station. It flies in on your screen, and one message asks the authority to count it.
Only the authority accepts a deposit, so the last log can't start two runs. If the station is full it answers no, and the log goes back on your back.
steps.code: if (!amAuthority()) return · msg({ k: 'no', to: from })

steps.text: Once a second the authority sends the whole shared railway. A late joiner is caught up by it, and a tab that drifted is put right.

Tree contact reserves room on your back and asks the authority to harvest. It orders simultaneous hits and returns a receipt. Only that accepted receipt awards wood, once; a full bag or hardwood rebound spends no tree progress.
steps.code: harvest request → harvestTree → harvested receipt → receiveHarvest

steps.text: Partial tree work and felled IDs use local saves and authority snapshots. Versioned messages isolate older place builds. This is not server-durable lockstep persistence; a crash before replication can still lose recent progress.
A great beam or boiler on your shoulder is in your presence too. If you leave carrying one, your partner's tab puts it back where it was picked up, so the railway never loses a piece.
